scope.primary: Warm independent MCP sessions: instructions, listed tool definitions, question, tools/call request, and all decoded text reply blocks joined with newlines. One copy of each is counted.
scope.alternatives: structured_only_tokens replaces text replies with compact structuredContent; null means unavailable. full_result_json_tokens replaces replies with complete serialized CallToolResult objects, including any duplicated content.
scope.raw: Identical question plus complete local CSV or complete document corpus, supplied directly as text. Raw market rows are neither copied to this report nor included in the traces.
scope.imports: Executed CLI imports counted separately as command payload plus full receipt. No shell-tool definition, API data-fetch cost, or upstream source acquisition is included.
scope.documents: Known artifact references, batched at 16, with exact excerpt or complete-content assertions. No checkpoint discovery or model tool-choice inference.
scope.lazy: Lazy profiles without discover assume the caller already knows each operation's arguments. lazy-discover explicitly fetches each used operation's schema once per session and includes that cost.
scope.limits: No provider billing, chat message envelopes, model reasoning, final answers, prompt caching, model reliability, or inference timing measured. Massive's own store_as/query_data workflow is not this raw replay baseline.

market_source.description: User-supplied local Massive aggregate CSV; not redistributed
